Description of the Solution & Mockups

Solution

#5238

  • every time user with canceled subscription which will expire in less than 14 days uses any paid feature, we well show them popup banner saying "You will lose this feature soon"
    • show it once per session
  • triggers to use
    • clicking on any pro features from tab:
      • autoscroll / smartscroll
      • chord games / autograde
      • print
      • simplify
      • transpose
    • when user opens official / pro tab

Decision

Results

  • have high conversion in reactivation: 8% iOS and 12% Android

Conclusion

No statistically significant effects were detected on iOS or Android across monetization, retention, or tab-view metrics (p ≥ 0.05). Given the absence of clear monetization lift and some sizable but non-significant negative trends on Android engagement (e.g., tab views per user down ~40%–44%, 1d retention down ~20%), do not roll out the current banner. Continue testing or iterate the UX/copy and targeting to reduce potential disruption, especially since the banner is shown once per session when users hit paywalled features or open official/pro tabs.


Next steps

  • fix analytics problem with subscription reactivation events and keep experiment running for a longer period
    • also add event for subscription expiration
